Dukan ki sale kaise badhaye? Sale ek number nahi, teen numbers ka gunaa hai: kitne customer aaye, kitnon ne kharida, aur har ek ne kitna liya. 📊

1. Customer wapas laaiye: har customer ka number save kijiye. Naya stock aaye to WhatsApp pe photo bhejiye.

2. Zyada log kharidein: pehle zaroorat aur budget poochiye, phir fayda samjhaiye, sirf features nahi.

3. Bill bada ho: budget se thoda upar ek behtar option dikhaiye. 400 bola to 450 wala bhi dikhaiye.
